description: A steel bulb of nitrous oxide. Forty seconds, and then you're just a person in a room again.

effects.comeon_message: Cold on the teeth, sweet at the back of the throat.

events.text: [trip]WAH. WAH. WAH. The whole room is on the beat.[/trip]
[trip]You're laughing and the laugh arrives in slices.[/trip]
[trip]The beat slows. Something almost gets explained.[/trip]
[trip]Gone. You're standing in a room holding a balloon, and it's a bit embarrassing.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Everything throbs in a steady beat, and you can't stop laughing.

overdose.message: You breathe the gas for too long and pass out without noticing.

phases.end_message: It wears off. You're just holding an empty balloon.

effects.take_line: You crack the {name} into a balloon and breathe it back in.

withdrawal.message: Your hands and feet have been tingling for days, and it's not pleasant.

stages.easing: It fades back to your fingertips and stays there.
stages.onset: Your hands and feet start tingling, with no balloon in sight.
stages.peak: The tingling hasn't stopped for an hour, and it's starting to worry you.
stages.rising: The tingling spreads through your fingers and feet, and it isn't pleasant.
stages.tail: It's mostly gone. Your feet still tingle now and then.

name: whippet
